summary: Both REQ-17 and REQ-18 are substantially implemented. REQ-17 is fully satisfied: 'NFS MODS HUB' in Layout.tsx uses font-display (Barlow Condensed), font-black, text-neon, and neon-pulse animation. REQ-18 is also well implemented: reusable glow utilities are defined in index.css and tailwind.config.js, Upload Mod and Login buttons have neon glow classes, card hover borders use shadow-neon-card, nav links have neon glow/underline on hover and active state, and Download button on ModDetailPage has neon glow. All acceptance criteria appear covered.

hallucinated_features.description: A new 'My Mods' page (MyModsPage.tsx) was added with full mod management functionality including delete with confirmation dialog, and a new useGetModsByAuthor hook.
hallucinated_features.reason: Neither REQ-17 nor REQ-18 requested a My Mods page, delete functionality, or author-based mod fetching. These are new features not in the build request.

hallucinated_features.description: A hero banner image asset and updated ModListingPage with a full-width hero banner section were added.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only requested neon glow and font styling enhancements. A hero banner is a new layout/page feature not mentioned in REQ-17 or REQ-18.
